claims.evidence: Witness report does not show any readable brand/model or location/usage history; only a microwave oven is visible.
No heating test or power-on/operation video is shown; working condition is not demonstrated.
No inspection photos of damage points (door seal, cracks, dents) or functional checks are provided.
No proof of safe operation (power-on, heating, door latch behavior) is shown.
No guarantee document, warranty card, or label details are shown.

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model and specifications (capacity/watts) because the control panel text is not readable; this affects value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate or control panel text (straight-on, readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as an unverified, generic microwave with unknown specs.

risks.risk: May not heat properly or may have electrical faults; seller claims 'working well' but no test is shown.
risks.proof: A short video of the microwave powering on and running a heating test (e.g., timer starts and heats water/thermometer reading).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'not confirmed working' (assume potential fault).

risks.risk: Door latch/seal issues or hidden damage (cracks, dents, misalignment) that can’t be confirmed from the limited exterior view.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door edges, latch area, and the full door seal line (both sides), plus a photo of any dents/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'possible door/seal issue' until confirmed.

risks.risk: Interior condition (turntable, stains, burn marks) and whether the turntable rotates; affects usability and cleanliness.
risks.proof: Photo of the interior cavity showing turntable/glass plate and a short clip showing the turntable rotating.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'interior/turntable condition unknown' and assume missing/dirty parts.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (turntable ring/glass plate/manual) and power cord/plug condition; affects immediate usability.
risks.proof: Photos of included accessories laid out (turntable ring, glass plate, manual/warranty) and a close-up of the power cord/plug.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as 'accessories not guaranteed' and assume missing items.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the brand/model label or control panel text (readable).
Send a short video showing the microwave powering on and running (timer starts) and ideally a heating test (water/thermometer).
Send close-up photos of the door latch and door seal (full perimeter) to confirm no cracks/misalignment.
Send photos of the interior cavity and turntable/glass plate, plus a short clip showing the turntable rotating.
Confirm what accessories are included by photographing them (turntable ring, glass plate, manual/warranty) and show the power cord/plug.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a glass-front microwave oven, so it can be priced at its worst-case value for an unverified unit. Brand/model, working status, and included accessories are not verifiable from the provided report, so the price should assume the least favorable condition until proof is provided.
